title: On managed hosting (Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Railway PostgreSQL), daily backups…
description: On managed hosting (Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Railway PostgreSQL), daily backups are provided by the platform's managed backup feature and are explicitly enabled and verified as part of environment provisioning — never left at an unverified default.
